image_description: A high-angle shot of a group of six hamsters huddled together on wood shavings and pink paper bedding. The subjects include a large golden/tan adult, a calico-patterned adult, and four smaller pups with black-and-white or grey-and-white markings. They are arranged in a loose cluster, some overlapping.

The visual evidence is insufficient to confirm this specific taxonomic trait.
Visible on the central golden hamster and the top calico hamster. Eyes appear as small, dark, bead-like structures consistent with the species.
Ears are visible on multiple subjects (especially the central golden one). They are rounded and proportionally large relative to the head size, matching the description.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: All subjects exhibit the characteristic rotund, compact body shape of hamsters. No elongated or weasel-like proportions are observed.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Dense short fur in golden, brown, black, or white coloration.
